summary: ALINGI AS (org. no. 935 080 169) is a private limited company (AS) based in Fredrikstad, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2025-03-12. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 82.990 (Annen forretningsmessig tjenesteyting ikke nevnt annet sted). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 745 114 and net income was -NOK 53 943. CEO: Grace Jacob Bullen; board chair: Grace Jacob Bullen.
